### FaQs

Please chat to our friendly team
or write us an email at

• What types of study programs do you offer?
We offer guidance for bachelor’s, master’s, and language programs across top universities worldwide — tailored to each student’s goals and background.
• Do you help with university applications?
Yes, our team assists with every step — from choosing the right university and program to completing applications and preparing documents.
• Can I apply if I haven’t decided on a destination yet?
Absolutely! Our advisors will help you explore your options and recommend the best study destinations based on your interests and budget.
• Do you provide visa support?
Yes, we guide students through the visa application process to ensure a smooth and successful submission.
• Are there scholarship opportunities?
Yes, we help students identify and apply for scholarships offered by universities and international organizations.
• Do you offer language preparation courses?
Yes, we provide preparation courses for IELTS, TOEFL, and other language exams required by universities.

### About us
UniStation is an education and career advisory platform dedicated to helping students build strong academic profiles and make informed decisions about their future. We support students who aspire to study abroad by providing personalized guidance tailored to their goals, abilities, and ambitions.
At UniStation, we believe that every student’s journey is unique. That is why we offer customized consultations covering university and major selection, academic and professional profile enhancement, application preparation, and end-to-end support throughout the admission process.
We specialize in international education systems, with a strong focus on more than 25 destinations, particularly English-taught programs. Our approach is practical, transparent, and student-centered, ensuring that each student receives clear, honest, and reliable advice.
Our mission is to be the starting point for ambitious students—transforming aspirations into clear plans and plans into successful outcomes.
Start Your Journey
### A LEGACYof Global Education
Guiding students to success since 2014, our organization has been a trusted partner in international education, empowering learners to achieve their academic dreams and build a global future.
Our history
• 2014
Foundation of Uni Station in Istanbul, Turkiye
• 2014
First group of students admitted to top universities
• 2016
Expansion of services to include language and test preparation programs
• 2022
Launch our regional office in Dubai, UAE
### our Team
• Founder of UniStation | Study Abroad & Education Adviso
### Basel Fayad
Basel Alfayad graduated from the Faculty of Education at Uludağ University in Turkey and has spent over a decade working closely with students from diverse backgrounds. Throughout his career, he has supported and guided more than 800 students from over 30 countries, helping them gain admission to universities across 25+ destinations worldwide. Based between Dubai and Istanbul, Basel’s work goes far beyond university placements. For him, education is not just a profession—it is a genuine passion. He regularly visits universities in person, listens to real student experiences, and maintains long-term relationships with his students even after they begin their studies. Basel continuously reassesses and updates the universities he recommends, relying on first-hand visits, student feedback, and the latest academic and institutional developments. Thisapproach ensures that every student receives honest, up-to-date, and carefully considered guidance. Through UniStation, Basel is committed to helping students make confident, informed decisions and build a future they truly believe in. In his free time, Basel enjoys traveling, reading, translation, and football.

###
Our English language programs are specifically designed for students who plan to studyabroad. We offer IELTS and TOEFL preparation courses based on a comprehensive andinternationally recognized curriculum that targets academic English and exam requirements.
Using modern teaching methodologies, we help students build the language skills, strategies,and confidence needed to achieve the required scores for university admission and succeed inan academic environment.
### FAQ
• 1. Who are these courses for?
These courses are designed for students who plan to study abroad and need IELTS or TOEFL scores for university admission.
‍
• 2. Which exam should I choose: IELTS or TOEFL?
The choice depends on your destination and university requirements. We guide each student in selecting the exam that best fits their study plan and target countries.
‍
• 3. What level of English do I need to join the course?
Students should have a basic to intermediate level of English. A placement assessment is conducted to determine the most suitable course level.
• 4. How long does the preparation course take?
Course duration varies based on the student’s current level and target score, typically ranging from a few weeks to several months.
• 5. Do the courses focus only on the exam or also academic English?
Our courses focus on both exam strategies and academic English skills required for success at international universities.
• 6. What is the price range for the preparation courses?
Our IELTS and TOEFL preparation courses are affordably priced, starting from AED 1,900 up to AED 4,499, depending on the course level, duration, and level of support provided
